text: Head-turn augmentation: extra random camera rotation on real-video rollouts, warped back for ground truth
description: Film camera motion is slow, so training holes are small (edges, disocclusions). In VR a head turn opens thick borders. Add random extra yaw/pitch to some rollout steps and later steps undo it (warp-back), so the large holes still have the real frame as target. Makes the push-pull fill + net learn big regenerations.

status.comment: train.turn (commit after 7368daa): virtual cameras turn away and back (sin profile), truth through the turned camera, masked loss; static-scene check passes. Used in run 'texture' (with texture loss): holes +2.3% vs push-pull (L1). Not yet compared in isolation.
